summary: Tested Stabilization Workstreams C (Front Porch CRM end to end) and D (applicant form, tokenized portal, uploads). Backend: the existing regression suites pass (test_stabilization_cd_admissions + test_crm_admissions + test_student_master, 60 passed). A new edge-case suite was added (12 tests, 11 pass): 1 HIGH bug, a fee-gate bypass through the /status endpoint. Code review found a HIGH issue: the public-form rate limit counts submissions by proxy IP. Frontend (desktop 1920 and mobile 390): every requested flow works end to end. Inquiry detail: the manual stage select lists only 4 stages, the readonly stage shows for application-driven stages, the pipeline strip highlights the current step, logging a call moves the lead to CONTACTED, the visit dialog moves it to VISIT_SCHEDULED, and the applicant link dialog shows the full URL and moves the lead to FORM_FILLED. Re-issuing a link sends the old token to 404. Follow-up queue: counts, rows and Done (prompt) all work, and next_followup_at is recalculated. Campus visits: the prospect name shows, and no_show logs a timeline activity. Form config saves. The public form at /apply/test-smoke-cd (mobile) works: classes and years render as dropdowns, the custom question q1 is validated, and submit redirects to /apply/t/{token}. Applicant portal (mobile): upload works, .txt gets 415, a missing DOB gets 422, the form is read-only after submit, and an invalid token shows ap-error. Application detail: approve sets the fee to Pending, Convert is disabled, the reference is required, Mark received enables Convert, conversion creates STU-2026-000001, a repeat convert returns already_converted, and the lead becomes ADMITTED with the readonly stage. Three UI bugs found: comma/space typing in the form config, no staff download button, and toasts covering the header buttons.

critical.issue: APP_TRANSITIONS allows APPROVED -> CONVERTED through the generic status endpoint. It returns 200 even while fee_status is pending, so the fee_pending gate is bypassed. The application becomes CONVERTED and the lead ADMITTED, but no Student is created (student_id stays None). The UI does not offer this option, but the API accepts it. Reproduced by test_status_endpoint_cannot_bypass_conversion.

PUBLIC_SUBMITS_PER_HOUR=10 is keyed on request.client.host. Behind the k8s ingress this is the proxy IP: public_form_submissions only contains 10.227.1.198 and 10.227.1.200. All applicants of a school therefore share about 2 buckets, and the whole public form returns 429 after roughly 10-20 submissions per hour. Use the first X-Forwarded-For entry (or uvicorn --proxy-headers with forwarded-allow-ips).

minor.issue: A manual move to NEW_INQUIRY, CONTACTED or VISIT_SCHEDULED is allowed even when the lead is at FORM_FILLED, UNDER_REVIEW, APPROVED or FEE_PENDING (UNDER_REVIEW -> NEW_INQUIRY returned 200). The lead stage then drifts from the application status. The UI hides the select in these stages, but the API should return 409 when lead.application_id is open.
The lead stays at FEE_PENDING after the fee is received (it only moves on conversion). Consider moving it to APPROVED, or labelling the stage 'Fee received' in the pipeline.

Custom question keys come from the list index after blank labels are skipped (here the first saved question got key 'q2'). Reordering or deleting questions renames keys, which orphans form_answers already stored on applications.
422 messages use raw field keys ('student_dob: required', 'parent_mobile: ...'), and applicants see these in toasts. Map them to human labels.

ui_bugs.issue: The controlled input re-renders csv(uncsv(value)) on every keystroke. Trailing spaces and commas are removed while typing, so typing 'Grade 1, Grade 2' on a real keyboard produces 'Grade1Grade2'. Admins cannot enter multi-word or multiple classes or options; it only works with paste or fill. Keep the raw string in local state and parse it on blur or save.

There is no view or download button for uploaded files: staff only see the filename. The backend endpoint /documents/{id}/download works, but nothing in the frontend references it, so the requirement 'downloadable to staff on the application detail page' is not met.

Stacked toasts sit over the header action buttons (app-change-status, app-convert) and intercept clicks for several seconds after verifying documents, so a user can't click Apply until the toasts expire.
window.prompt is used for the notes, and pressing Cancel still completes the follow-up (prompt returns null and `?? null` carries on). Cancel should abort; use a shadcn Dialog instead.

issues: Custom answers are shown by internal key ('q1 · Friend') instead of the question label
The converted badge shows 'STUDENT #E3AFBA' (an ObjectId suffix) instead of the student_number STU-2026-000001
Staff Upload buttons stay active on CONVERTED applications and verified docs
Automatic stage changes for contacts and visits are labelled 'APPLICATION UPDATE' even when no application exists
Next follow-up and the follow-up due date use a native datetime-local; the visit date uses a native date input (not shadcn Calendar)
A native <select> and checkbox are used next to shadcn controls
The delete (trash) icon is very low contrast
The status card title wraps as 'Application ADM-2026-' / '000003 ·' with a dangling separator; there is no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390)
Console shows 401 errors on public pages (the auth bootstrap calls /auth/me or refresh for anonymous visitors), which is harmless but noisy
The /apply/schoolos-foundation-1 slug from the request does not exist: it shows 'School not found'. Testing used /apply/test-smoke-cd

action_items: HIGH: remove APP_CONVERTED from the generic /status transitions (or reject CONVERTED in change_application_status) so that only the conversion service, with its fee gate, can convert
HIGH: key the public apply rate limit on the real client IP (X-Forwarded-For) instead of the ingress IP
HIGH: fix the fc-classes, fc-years and fc-q-options CSV inputs so users can type commas and spaces (keep raw text state, parse on blur or save)
HIGH: add a staff view/download button per uploaded document on ApplicationDetailPage (GET /documents/{id}/download as a blob)
MEDIUM: keep toasts from covering the header actions (bottom-right position, or fewer stacked success toasts)

LOW: block manual stage moves while an open application exists; show question labels instead of keys in applicant-extras; show student_number in the converted badge; make Cancel on the follow-up prompt abort; use human-readable validation messages
critical_code_review_comments: admission.py APP_TRANSITIONS APPROVED -> {CONVERTED, WITHDRAWN}: CONVERTED should be reachable only through conversion.convert_application_to_student
applicant_routes.public_apply: the request.client.host rate limit is ineffective and harmful behind the proxy
applicant_routes.put_form_config: question key f'q{i+1}' depends on the index; generate keys only for new questions and keep existing ones
crm_routes.move_stage: no check against lead.application_id or the current application-driven stage before a manual backwards move
crm_routes.py is 775 lines (over the 700 guideline); consider splitting out followups and visits

success_rate.backend: 96% (71/72 including regressions; 1 HIGH bug, plus 1 HIGH rate-limit issue found in code review)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all requested flows work; 2 HIGH UI gaps: CSV typing and no document download)

test_credentials: owner@test-smoke-cd.example.com / SchoolOwner@123 (slug test-smoke-cd). The edge-case suite registers fresh test-stab-<run> schools.
seed_data_creation: In test-smoke-cd: lead INQ-2026-000002 'UiLead Iter18' (now ADMITTED, student STU-2026-000001, app ADM-2026-000002); public application ADM-2026-000003 'Mobi Iter18' (SUBMITTED); 2 follow-ups and 1 campus visit (no_show). The form config was set to classes [Grade 1, Grade 2], years [2026-27], intro 'Welcome to Smoke Academy iter18', and a required select q1 'How did you hear about us?' [Friend, Ad]. Fresh test-stab-* schools were also created by pytest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported; the pytest.ini uses xdist, so use -n 0 for module-state suites (test_stabilization_cd_edgecases uses a module fixture). Login wait: the host contains 'schoolos', so wait_for_url('**/school**') matches /login; use the regex r'.*/school(/.*)?$'. Toasts intercept header button clicks, so use force=True. Retest: /status CONVERTED is rejected, the rate limit uses XFF, CSV inputs accept real typing, and a staff document download button exists.
rca of the issue: Fee bypass: the APP_TRANSITIONS map still includes APPROVED->CONVERTED from before conversion.py existed, and change_application_status trusts that map; sync_lead_from_application then maps CONVERTED -> ADMITTED. Repro: approve an application with the fee rule on, then POST /status {status: CONVERTED}: the response is 200, the lead becomes ADMITTED, and no student is created. CSV input: value={csv(arr)} with onChange={uncsv(e.target.value)} normalises on every keystroke, removing the trailing ', ' and ' ' before the next character arrives.
